notes: Lesson sequences are taken from the individual unit sheets.
Overview is used for timetable/session information and explicit special-week entries.
Where a class has several unit sheets, multiple lessons may appear in the same week rather than guessing which timetable slot belongs to each unit.
All lesson page links have intentionally been left blank.

lessons.title: Introduction to PLC programming
lessons.description: Covers getting into TIA portal, basic inputs and outputs (NO and NC), output coils, logic gates, latches. Students are shown how each component/function works then they recreate it and add it to a word document explaining it.

lessons.title: Advanced PLC functions
lessons.description: Covers memory locations, timers (TON and TOF), counters (CTU, CTD, CTUD), comparators. Students are shown how each component/function works then they recreate it and add it to a word document explaining it.

lessons.title: Sequential programming
lessons.description: Covers move functions, sequential programming methodology, both with boolean and integers. Students are shown how each component/function works then they recreate it and add it to a word document explaining it.

lessons.title: PLC handout and connection
lessons.description: Hand out the PLCs to students, a lot of admin around that process. Talk students through setting up siemens TIA to talk to PLC and how to plug it in correctly. Produce a couple of simple programs and have them run

lessons.title: First mini project
lessons.description: A project to put together everything learnt so far, based on an industrial scenario with conveyors and sensors, should be using PLCs to make it more practical and visual

lessons.title: Second mini project
lessons.description: A slightly harder project which again puts together everything learnt so far, again based on an industrial scenario but including branching decisions this time

lessons.title: Third mini project
lessons.description: Again stepping up project difficulty, this time the students receive a paragraph they must split themselves to make a program. Along side this they receive a completed tag table. Again in an industrial scenario

lessons.title: Fourth mini project
lessons.description: Much like the 3rd mini project but expanded

lessons.title: Actuator/Sensor Notation
lessons.description: Covers PLC notation including both pneumatic and electric notation. Students will program examples of each notation based on a worksheet

lessons.title: Plug in components demonstration
lessons.description: Split the class in groups, groups watch as tutor or LA shows them how to plug in components like pneumatic pistons, motors, sensors ect. Whilst the groups are watching the demonstration the rest are finishing the worksheet from the last lesson

lessons.title: Plug in components
lessons.description: Split the class in groups, each group has their own pneumatic bench to work on, they plug in all the components they learnt about in the previous lesson, if they have time they start on their first "plug in" project (see next lesson)

lessons.title: Plug in components - project
lessons.description: Students are split into the same groups as last lesson and given a project to create a program then plug in the components for that program to make a complete working system

classes.name: Year 2 BTEC Apps – Unit 31 Electrical Machines

lessons.title: AC Motors
lessons.description: Covers AC Motors, construction, operation, single phase, multi phase, synchronous, asynchronous, slip equation, speed equation

lessons.title: AC motors - VFD and Shaded Pole
lessons.description: Covers VFD, Shaded Pole Motors and Universal Motors

lessons.title: AC motors - Practical
lessons.description: Students do some further research tasks whilst pairs come up and wire a 3 phase and 1 phase AC motor based on a diagram then look at frequency, load, speed and torque characteristics

lessons.title: AC Generators
lessons.description: Covers AC Generators, single phase, multiphase, stator, rotor field, stator field

lessons.title: Transformers
lessons.description: Covers transformer types, step up, step down, isolation, construction

lessons.title: Relays #1
lessons.description: Discuss how relays function (their physical construction) then go on to discuss how to use fluid sim to wire up a basic circuit incluing NO, NC, Latch

lessons.title: Relays #2
lessons.description: Explore how we can construct boolean logic circuits from relays including timers. Again large focus on building in fluid sim

lessons.title: Relays #3
lessons.description: Explore how to setup sequential relay systems using latches and other components. Again large focus on building in fluid sim

lessons.title: Units of measurement
lessons.description: Covers imperial and metric measurements, SI units (Base and Derived), multipliers and submultipliers

lessons.title: Electronic theory basics
lessons.description: Covers atomic structure (conduction and valence bands), conventional and electron flow, charge, current, voltage, resistance, V=IR, Energy, Power, Electric Force

lessons.title: Sensors, actuators and controllers
lessons.description: Covers types of sensors,  electronic actuators, pneumatic actuators, hydraulic actuators, types of controllers (PLC, Microcontroller, Microcomputer), Microprocessors

lessons.title: Vectors & coordinates
lessons.description: Covers scalar and vector quantities, drawing vectors, vector notation, adding vectors, polar and cartesian notation

lessons.title: Resistors
lessons.description: Covers different types of resistors like carbon film, metal film, wire wound, potentiometers, rheostats, LDR, thermistor, varistor, current limiting, potential dividers

lessons.title: Encoders
lessons.description: Covers the different types of encoders, optical, resistive, mechanical, magnetic

lessons.title: Vectors and SI units project
lessons.description: A project where students are given a scenario of a drone in an emergency situation and have to complete many tasks to do with vectors and SI units - Solo project

lessons.title: Resistors in series and parallel
lessons.description: Covers the equations for resistors in series and parallel

lessons.description: Covers the scientific method including observations, questioning, hypothesis, prediction, testing, conclusion and iteration

lessons.title: Reliable data
lessons.description: Covers different types of errors, uncertainty, repeatability, bias

lessons.title: Resistors
lessons.description: Covers what resistors are, includes current limiting, potential dividers, current dividers, resistors in series and parallel

lessons.title: Simulating circuits
lessons.description: Covers use of circuit wizard, explaining how to use the software, how to measure and record values, taking circuit diagrams and putting them in the software. Should include an aspect of looking at dividers and total resistance

lessons.title: Building circuits
lessons.description: Students take the circuits they simulated in the last lesson and physically build them measuring values as they go, looking at current and voltage and checking it matches up with what the simulation gave them
